name: A9 | SOC Copilot - AI tổng hợp alerts

parameters.query:
SELECT id, alert_type, severity, ip_address, title, status, created_at 
FROM alerts 
WHERE status != 'resolved'
ORDER BY created_at DESC 
LIMIT 50
SELECT ip_address, country, threat_type, severity, hits FROM threats WHERE status = 'watching' ORDER BY hits DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT id, code, title, severity, status, progress 
FROM investigations 
ORDER BY started_at DESC 
LIMIT 10
